facts.text: The Honda CMBS investigations are United States regulatory inquiries into cars whose Collision Mitigation Braking System braked hard with nothing in the way, described as the largest documented case of unnecessary automatic braking reaching a production fleet.
facts.quote: The Honda investigations are the United States regulator's inquiries into cars whose Collision Mitigation Braking System braked hard with nothing in the way, the largest documented case of unnecessary automatic braking reaching a production fleet.

facts.text: Honda's Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS) is Honda's name for its automatic emergency braking (AEB).
facts.quote: Honda's Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS) is the maker's name for its automatic emergency braking (AEB).

facts.text: NHTSA opened Preliminary Evaluation PE22-003 on 21 February 2022 with 278 complaints of inadvertent Honda CMBS activation: 107 Accord complaints and 171 CR-V complaints, with six alleging a collision and some reporting large speed changes with nothing obstructing the vehicle's path.
facts.quote: opened Preliminary Evaluation PE22-003 on 21 February 2022 with 278 complaints (107 Accord, 171 CR-V) of inadvertent activation, six alleging a collision, "some with large speed changes, occurring with nothing obstructing the vehicle's path"

facts.text: In April 2024, NHTSA upgraded the Honda CMBS case to Engineering Analysis EA24-002, covering 2,997,604 vehicles—2018–2022 Accord and 2017–2022 CR-V, including hybrids—and 1,294 complaints.
facts.quote: In April 2024 it upgraded the case to Engineering Analysis EA24-002, covering 2,997,604 vehicles (2018 to 2022 Accord and 2017 to 2022 CR-V, including hybrids) and 1,294 complaints.

facts.text: Reported crash and injury counts for the Honda CMBS investigation differ by outlet, ranging from 31 crashes and 50 injuries to 47 crashes and 93 injuries.
facts.quote: Crash and injury counts differ by outlet, from 31 crashes and 50 injuries to 47 crashes and 93 injuries [Chapter 2].

facts.text: In January 2025, further Honda CMBS analysis EA25-002 added 295,125 Insight and Passport vehicles.
facts.quote: A further analysis, EA25-002, added 295,125 Insight and Passport vehicles in January 2025

facts.text: For Honda CMBS analysis EA25-002, Honda cited about 412 reports, while NHTSA reviewed 475 reports in total.
facts.quote: Honda cited about 412 reports, dealer technicians who could not replicate the fault told customers it was "normal AEB operation", and the agency reviewed 475 reports in total

facts.text: Honda dealer technicians who could not replicate the CMBS fault told customers that the behavior was "normal AEB operation".
facts.quote: dealer technicians who could not replicate the fault told customers it was "normal AEB operation"

facts.text: Honda's own review concluded that some customers did not understand CMBS or its limits.
facts.quote: Honda's own review concluded that some customers did not understand the system or its limits

facts.text: According to secondary sources, no recall had been ordered in the Honda CMBS case as of 2026.
facts.quote: no recall had been ordered as of 2026 according to secondary sources [Chapter 2].

facts.text: None of the Honda CMBS investigations shows that weak pre-production validation caused the field problem.
facts.quote: None of the investigations shows that weak pre-production validation caused the field problem

facts.text: The Honda CMBS investigations establish that unnecessary braking reached very large production fleets and occupied the regulator for years.
facts.quote: they establish that unnecessary braking reached very large fleets and kept the regulator busy for years [Chapter 2].

facts.text: The booklet presents the Tesla investigation closed in June 2026 as a counterexample: about 25,900 reports, zero crashes, and reports that fell steeply after firmware updates.
facts.quote: The Tesla investigation closed in June 2026 is the counterexample: about 25,900 reports, zero crashes, and reports that fell steeply after firmware updates [Chapter 2].

facts.text: The booklet concludes that unnecessary braking is the dominant documented failure mode of production automatic braking, so a validation campaign measured only by collisions avoided is incomplete.
facts.quote: "Unnecessary braking is the dominant documented failure mode" of production automatic braking, so a validation campaign measured only by collisions avoided is incomplete [Chapter 2].

facts.text: The Honda dealer episode indicates that complaints that cannot be reproduced in the workshop are an early warning sign to watch for in field pilots.
facts.quote: The dealer episode shows that complaints which cannot be reproduced in the workshop are an early warning sign to watch for in field pilots [Chapter 13].
